data.name: Digitum
data.detailed_description:
Step into a magical adventure like no other!

Have you ever wondered what it would be like to be a rock, an olive, or a small, perfectly rollable sphere?
Ever dreamed of racing downhill at breakneck speed, just to go faster than your friends and claim victory?
Look no further—welcome to Digitum!

Here, you take on the role of an old, used magician, pushing objects through finger-sized portals simply because… well, you’re bored and you can.

As the player, you control one of these curious little objects, guiding it from portal to portal in a never-ending game of whimsical physics and chaotic fun, trying to improve the time you take to finish a level !

The goal of the game is to complete each level as quickly as possible while avoiding obstacles that add time to your timer.

To move forward, you give an impulse to the object you control. A loading bar displayed beneath the object indicates the strength of the impulse. If the bar turns red, an additional boost is triggered, making you go even faster.

The game features a multiplayer mode with a real-time leaderboard showing the scores of your friends and the top players.

Many successes can be unlocked by completing challenges — some of which are hidden — and allow you to obtain new skins for your object.

data.short_description: A bored old wizard pokes his finger into a tiny portal — and you fall out! In this fast-paced arcade adventure, race through twisted levels, master the physics, and perfect your runs to beat the clock… and your friends on the leaderboard.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French*, Spanish - Spain*
*languages with full audio support
data.reviews:
“What an adventure, going into each level felt like the first breath of a newborn; the music transcends you into an other plan of reality. Never have I ever experienced such a feeling while playing a video game. I especially recommend it to people stressed by daily life routine.”
10 – Metacritic

“Amazing game! Loved the atmosphere and music! The progression system feels so rewarding, even though the first level is a bit tricky”
9 – Metacritic
